pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: lib/db/pglite/ddl.ts:1 This context is the embedded-Postgres persistence substrate (schema, WAL, checkpoint, store copy); a case-insensitive grep of lib/db/pglite for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, McpServer, tools/list and inputSchema returned zero hits, and package.json declares no MCP SDK, so no tool server or client exists here.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: features/volby/volbyLoader.ts:1 The /volby context is server-only page loaders plus React components that render for human readers, not a tool surface that a model calls; grep of features/volby for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, McpServer, tools/list and inputSchema found nothing.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: scripts/hybrid-bench/engine.ts:30 The benchmark spawns the Claude CLI in print mode, passing only --model and --effort beyond these base args: no MCP config, no tool allow-list, and no tool server of its own (grep of scripts/hybrid-bench for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, McpServer, tools/list and inputSchema found nothing). It is an LLM call wrapper, not a tool-protocol host or server.
pairs.registryProposal: Consider a note in the golden path's 'what is not this subject' section saying that spawning an agent CLI in headless print mode with no tool configuration is out of scope, so seats do not confuse an LLM subprocess wrapper with a tool-protocol consumer.
